title: ECC Approves Rs. 275 Billion for Water Projects
excerpt: The Economic Coordination Committee has cleared a Technical Supplementary Grant of Rs. 275 billion to fund key water sector projects.
body_html:
The Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) of the Cabinet has cleared a significant financial package for the country's infrastructure. During a recent meeting, the committee approved a Technical Supplementary Grant totaling Rs. 275 billion.

The newly approved funds are specifically designated for important water sector projects. This financial allocation aims to support development initiatives within the water sector, though specific project names and locations were not detailed in the announcement.
